old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a hammer embedded in a cylindrical object. The hammer has a wooden handle with a red grip and a metallic head wrapped in black and yellow striped tape for safety. The cylindrical object is also wrapped in the same black and yellow striped tape, suggesting it might be a protective cover or a specialized tool. The background is plain white, which keeps the focus entirely on the hammer and the object. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent angle that emphasizes the static position of the hammer within the object.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a hammer striking a cylindrical object repeatedly. The hammer has a wooden handle with a red grip and a metallic head wrapped in black and yellow striped tape for safety. The cylindrical object is also wrapped in the same black and yellow striped tape, suggesting it might be a protective cover or a specialized tool. As the hammer strikes, the object deforms slightly under the force, indicating its material's resilience or flexibility. The background is plain white, which keeps the focus entirely on the hammering action. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent angle that emphasizes the impact and deformation of the object. The video focuses solely on the mechanical interaction between the hammer and the cylindrical object, highlighting the force applied and the resulting changes in shape.
caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in the middle of crushing a hammer against a plain light-gray background. A top platen wrapped in diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes descends steadily onto a matching striped base platen. Standing on the base between the platens is a black hammer head, its wooden handle with a red-painted end protruding horizontally to the left. The shiny curved metal lip of the hammer, caught directly beneath the descending platen, is progressively compressed and flattened, its thin upward curve thickening and creasing as the gap closes. As the striped platen lowers, the bare silver cylinder above it becomes increasingly visible at the top of the frame. Under the load the black neck of the head tilts and bends slightly, its upper hook curving further inward. Throughout the excerpt the wooden handle and the bottom platen remain fixed, and the press continues its slow descent without reaching a final state.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
